templates.name: Battery saver auto-on
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Turns battery saver on by itself when the battery drops to 20%, so you never run out of power because you forgot to flip the switch.

templates.name: Battery full alert
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Vibrates and notifies you when the battery reaches 95% while charging, so you can unplug in time and go easy on the cell.

templates.name: Low battery warning
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Notifies and buzzes when the battery falls below 15% and the phone is not charging.

templates.name: Overnight quiet charging
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Plugs in at night: switches the phone to alarms-only (Do not disturb) and dims the screen while the charge runs between 22:00 and 07:00.

templates.name: Overnight quiet — restore on unplug
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: The counterpart to 'Overnight quiet charging': unplugging the charger ends alarms-only mode and puts brightness back to adaptive.

templates.name: Dark theme with battery saver (on)
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Battery saver switched on? The system dark theme comes with it — easy on the eyes and the battery at the same time.

templates.name: Dark theme with battery saver (off)
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: When battery saver turns off again, dark theme is switched back off.

templates.name: Bedtime — alarms only
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Every night at 23:00 the phone goes to alarms-only (Do not disturb). Alarms still ring, everything else stays quiet.

templates.name: Morning — end do not disturb
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Every morning at 07:00 do not disturb is switched off and the phone is audible again.

templates.name: Hourly water reminder
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: A gentle notification every hour between 09:00 and 21:00 reminding you to drink water — the classic health nudge.

templates.name: Evening journal prompt
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: At 21:30 a notification asks how your day was — the journaling habit, borrowed from the most-saved Apple Shortcuts.

templates.name: Wi-Fi on when arriving home
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: When you enter your home area, Wi-Fi switches on automatically. Edit the trigger to set your own coordinates and radius.

templates.name: Wi-Fi off when leaving home
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: When you leave your home area, Wi-Fi switches off to save battery. Edit the trigger to set your own coordinates and radius.

templates.name: Work mode — silence on office Wi-Fi
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Detecting your office Wi-Fi switches the phone to silent+vibrate. Replace the SSID with your workplace network.

templates.name: Work mode — leave office Wi-Fi
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Losing your office Wi-Fi restores the normal loud ringer. Replace the SSID with your workplace network.

templates.name: Bluetooth auto-off
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: When no Bluetooth device has been connected for 5 minutes, Bluetooth switches off to save battery.

templates.name: Car mode — maps + greeting
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: When your phone pairs with the car, Google Maps opens and a voice wishes you a safe drive. Set your head unit's Bluetooth name in the trigger.

templates.name: Headphones in — launch music
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Plugging in headphones opens your music app straight away — the Tasker classic. Set your preferred app's package in the action.

templates.name: Headphones out — pause
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Unplugging the headphones pauses whatever is playing — no more music blasting from the speaker.

templates.name: Screen off — pause music
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Locking the screen pauses media playback — handy for podcasts you keep losing track of.

templates.name: Flip to silence a call
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Turn the phone face-down while a call is ringing to silence it — the classic flip-to-mute, no button needed.

templates.name: Shake to toggle flashlight
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Shake the phone to toggle the flashlight — find the keyhole without unlocking.

templates.name: Double-press power for camera
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Press the power button twice to open the camera — like the stock shortcut, built from a trigger that counts screen-off toggles.

templates.name: Home-screen torch button
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Add this macro's widget to your home screen for a one-tap flashlight toggle.

templates.name: Home-screen Wi-Fi button
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: A home-screen widget that toggles Wi-Fi with one tap.

templates.name: Anti-theft: text 'locate' for GPS reply
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Text this phone the word 'locate' and it replies by SMS with its current GPS coordinates — find a lost or stolen phone from any other phone.

templates.name: Driving auto-reply
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: While a Bluetooth device is connected (your car), any incoming SMS gets an automatic reply sent from its notification — 'I'm driving'.

templates.name: Quiet-hours missed call note
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: A missed call between 22:00 and 07:00 leaves you a notification, so overnight callers are never forgotten.

templates.name: Weekly mobile data report
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Every Monday at 08:00 the week's mobile data usage is measured and posted as a notification.

templates.name: Morning weather briefing (TTS)
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Weekday mornings the phone fetches today's weather (Open-Meteo, no API key) and reads it aloud. Edit the URL to your own latitude/longitude.

templates.name: Hold volume button — mute/restore media
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Long-press a volume button to mute media instantly; long-press again to restore the exact level you had (ported from BespredeL's Fast Media Vol.). The current level is remembered in the 'level' variable, so mute/restore round-trips perfectly.

templates.name: Shake flashlight (dark only)
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Shake the phone to toggle the flashlight — but only when it matters: the macro only reacts while the screen is on, the device is locked and the phone is not face-down on a table (ported from BespredeL's Flashlight). In daylight a shake turns the torch back off so it never burns in your pocket.

templates.name: Shake for contact QR
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Shake the phone on your home screen and a QR code with your contact details appears full-screen — let people scan you instead of dictating numbers (ported from BespredeL's ShakeContacts). Change the qrText in the action to your number or link: tel:+10000000000, https://t.me/yourhandle or https://wa.me/10000000000.

templates.name: Anti-scam call guard
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: While you are on a call, an incoming SMS or notification that looks like a verification code (4-8 characters) triggers full scam defense (ported from BespredeL's Anti-Scam macro): the code notification is wiped from the shade, an alert SMS goes to a trusted contact, a loud warning appears, and a dialog offers End call — if nobody touches it for 30 seconds the call hangs up automatically. Replace the number in the Send SMS action with your trusted contact.
needs: Edit the trusted phone number in the Send SMS action

templates.name: Intruder camera on failed unlock
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: After 2 failed unlock attempts within 10 minutes the front camera snaps a photo, GPS coordinates are captured, and both are saved to /sdcard/OpenMacro/IntruderCam together with a Google Maps link in a timestamped text file, followed by a notification (ported from BespredeL's IntruderCam; the rear-camera shot, 30 s video and the browser-based map viewer of the 89-action original were dropped for the store build).

templates.name: Child device activity reporter
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Turns a child's phone into a reporter: every call (incoming/missed/outgoing), SMS, notification, Wi-Fi-free GPS position every 15 minutes and app install/removal is sent as an HTTP request to your own receiver URL (ported from BespredeL's Parental Control; the parent-side viewer and offline archive of the 220-action original are out of scope — the receiver stores what it gets). Fields from triggers that did not fire arrive as literal {token} text — have the receiver ignore those.
needs: Your own HTTP receiver (e.g. a small script on your VPS) — put its URL into the request action

templates.name: LAN file server (JSON API)
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Exposes the phone's files to your Wi-Fi: an HTTP endpoint lists a folder as JSON, deletes a file, or creates a folder — no cloud, LAN only (ported from BespredeL's Remote Filemanager; the 92-action original serves a full HTML UI, this build is the JSON API it talks to). Open http://<phone-ip>:<port>/rfm?cmd=list&dir=/sdcard in a browser or script — the port shows when the macro arms. Add &name=<file> for delete, or cmd=mkdir to create a folder.
needs: Same Wi-Fi network as the client

templates.name: Wake PC (Wake-on-LAN)
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Powers on a computer on your network with a Wake-on-LAN magic packet: run the macro or tap its home-screen widget and the packet goes to the broadcast address on UDP port 9 (ported from BespredeL's Wake PC; the original's settings scenes are replaced by three plain variables). Set the 'mac' variable to your PC's MAC and the UDP action's destination to your network's broadcast (usually your IP with .255 at the end). The PC must have Wake-on-LAN enabled in its BIOS/UEFI and NIC driver.
needs: Wake-on-LAN enabled on the target PC
Edit the 'mac' variable and the UDP destination broadcast address

templates.name: Telegram device bot
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Controls this phone from a private Telegram chat: /ping answers, /geo replies with a Google Maps link of the current position, /ring plays a sound at full media volume, /reject_call ends the current call — anything else prints the command list (ported from BespredeL's Simple Telegram Bot, trimmed to its core commands; the original's note-taking, VirusTotal and DeepSeek commands were dropped). Only your Telegram user id is accepted — put it into the first If condition and your bot token into the 'botToken' variable.
needs: Bot token from @BotFather — put it into the 'botToken' variable
Public webhook: OpenMacro webhooks are LAN-only, so forward a port from your VPS (89.116.128.227) to the phone and set the Telegram webhook to http://89.116.128.227:<port>/tgbot
Your Telegram user id (ask @userinfobot) in the two If conditions

templates.name: Telegram away auto-reply
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: Answers incoming Telegram Business messages when you are away: after a 60-second grace period (so you can answer manually first) the sender gets your away message (ported from BespredeL's Telegram Secretary; the AI reply of the original is replaced by the configurable away text because on-device AI is not built into OpenMacro yet — to answer with an LLM instead, extend the final branch: POST the message to any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, parse the reply with JsonParse and read {lv=ai[choices][0][message][content]}). Send /start from your own account once to register you as the owner.
needs: Bot token from @BotFather — put it into the 'botToken' variable
Public webhook: OpenMacro webhooks are LAN-only, so forward a port from your VPS (89.116.128.227) to the phone and set the Telegram webhook to http://89.116.128.227:<port>/tgsec
Send /start from your own Telegram account once to register the owner

templates.name: YouTube ad skipper
templates.author: BespredeL
templates.description: While YouTube is in the foreground: when a 'Skip' button appears it is tapped for you, when an ad's 'Visit advertiser' label shows up media is muted, and when the label disappears your volume comes back (ported from BespredeL's AutoSkip YouTube Ads; the Shorts flow and the 79-language detection of the original were dropped — matched texts are for the English UI, edit them in the triggers for other languages). Needs the accessibility service for screen reading and tapping.
needs: English YouTube UI — edit the matched texts in the triggers for other languages

templates.name: Forward SMS to email
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Every incoming SMS is emailed to you (IFTTT: Forward Android SMS to your Email inbox). Set your SMTP account in OpenMacro's More tab and put your address in the Send Email action.

templates.name: 6 AM weather email
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: At 6:00 every morning you get an email with the current weather (Open-Meteo, no API key). Edit the latitude/longitude in the URL and the address in the email action.

templates.name: Stock below price alert
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Every 15 minutes the price of your stock is fetched (Yahoo Finance chart feed, no key) and you get a notification once it falls below your limit. Edit the symbol at the end of the URL (AAPL, MSFT, ...) and the limit in the condition; you are notified once per drop.

templates.name: Daily currency rate log
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Once a day the USD to EUR rate is fetched (Frankfurter, no key) and appended as a line to /sdcard/OpenMacro/rates.csv, ready to open in any spreadsheet. Change the currency codes in the URL.

templates.name: NASA picture of the day wallpaper
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Each morning the NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day becomes your wallpaper. Uses NASA's public DEMO_KEY; get a free key at api.nasa.gov for heavy use. Days when NASA posts a video instead of an image are skipped.
needs: Storage folder /sdcard/OpenMacro (grant all-files access in Android settings)

templates.name: Hue lights on when I arrive home
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Turns every Philips Hue light on when you arrive home. Talks to your Hue bridge on the local network (no cloud, no account). Set the bridge IP and your API username in the macro variables (press the bridge button, then POST a devicetype body to http://<bridge>/api to get one) and the home coordinates in the trigger.
needs: Philips Hue bridge on the same Wi-Fi

templates.name: Hue lights off when I leave home
templates.author: openmacro
templates.description: Turns every Philips Hue light off when you leave home. Talks to your Hue bridge on the local network (no cloud, no account). Set the bridge IP and your API username in the macro variables (press the bridge button, then POST a devicetype body to http://<bridge>/api to get one) and the home coordinates in the trigger.
needs: Philips Hue bridge on the same Wi-Fi
